resume_text:
RIYA SHARMA
B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering, 3rd year
Vishwakarma Institute of Technology, Pune | CGPA 8.4 / 10 | Expected 2027
riya.sharma.demo@example.com | github.com/riya-sharma-demo | Pune, Maharashtra

OBJECTIVE
Looking for an ML engineering internship where I can work on real datasets and
take a model from a notebook to something a team can actually use.

SKILLS
Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS
Machine learning: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, matplotlib, seaborn
Deep learning: TensorFlow (coursework), PyTorch basics, CNN fundamentals
Other: Jupyter, Git, Flask, NLP, statistics, data cleaning, feature engineering,
Excel, React (one project)

PROJECTS
Crop yield prediction (Jan 2026 to Mar 2026)
Random forest on rainfall, soil and area data for 12 districts of Maharashtra.
Cleaned and merged three inconsistent sources, engineered rolling rainfall and
monsoon onset features. Validation R2 0.71 with 5 fold cross validation.

Movie recommender (Jul 2026)
TF-IDF and cosine similarity recommender with a Flask API and a small web page.
Served a JSON endpoint consumed by the front end.

Tweet sentiment analysis (Jul 2026)
NLP pipeline with NLTK preprocessing and TF-IDF features. Logistic regression
and linear SVM compared, best macro F1 0.80.

Marks dashboard (Jun 2026)
Streamlit dashboard for class internal marks with subject wise distributions,
used by our class representative every semester.

COURSEWORK
Data Structures and Algorithms, Database Management Systems, Probability and
Statistics, Machine Learning (elective), Operating Systems, Computer Networks

ACHIEVEMENTS
- Second place, college level data analysis hackathon, 2026
- 180 problems solved on LeetCode, daily practice repository maintained
- Completed Machine Learning Specialisation coursework on Coursera

POSITIONS
Technical team member, Data Science Club: conducted two pandas workshops for
second year students.
